content: GitHub Pages publishes static files and does not support server-side application languages. Browser-visible code cannot hold secrets, guarantee form delivery, or perform durable server-side lead joins. Custom routes need emitted files or a fallback strategy. GitHub also states Pages is not intended as free hosting for a site primarily facilitating commercial transactions or SaaS and lists bandwidth, site-size and rate limits, so hosting suitability should be reviewed as the funnel becomes transactional.
